name: Singularity
promptTemplate: A black hole in {{palette}} hues spinning at {{spin}}x speed with {{disk_density}} density plasma, {{doppler_strength}}x Doppler beaming, {{lens_flare}} anamorphic flare, rendered in {{upscale_style}}

spin.hint: Spins plasma around the event horizon

disk_density.hint: Adds turbulent shear bands to the disk

upscale_style.hint: Select smooth scaling, raw pixels, or CRT

listing.blurb: A spinning black hole pulls a glowing accretion disk over its dark event horizon, bending background stars into Einstein rings while viewers tweak spin velocity and Doppler beaming.
listing.prompt: A black hole with a blazing accretion disk, the far side of the disk lensed up and over the shadow into a bright ring, Doppler-bright on the approaching side, the starfield behind it smeared into arcs, all on a low-resolution buffer. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
